assessments.rationale: Clean-subject execution verifies expanded internal telemetry, including supplied campaigns, canonical profile/contract captures, same-week contract result attribution and information-report provenance across week-close. Actual domain/harness evidence is distinguished from constructed attribution and intake fixtures. Conditional queue/cadence/selector diagnostics, full information-model coverage, exhaustive consequence delivery and deeper profile-sensitive producer integration remain incomplete or unverified. This is complementary evidence, not an integrated release census or whole-owner completion.

No unrelated release-dimension execution or current full-build observation is supplied.
